claim: NP-completeness under polynomial-time many-one reductions of conservative chip-firing halting for nonnegative configurations on finite loopless simple strongly connected directed graphs; hardness even when deleting one vertex leaves a depth-at-most-one DAG and total chips are polynomially bounded in SAT input length.

oriented_graph_strengthening.claim: The same hardness holds for oriented graphs with no antiparallel arcs; uses directed three-cycle trivial instances.

reduction: Polynomial-time many-one reduction from 3-SAT to HALTING.
membership_credit: Farrell and Levine, CoEulerian graphs, Section 3; report Section 7 gives a self-contained simple-graph certificate specialization.
chip_encoding_scope: Nonnegative binary inputs; hardness holds with polynomial total chips and therefore also unary chip encoding.
exact_graph_scope: Finite loopless simple strongly connected conservative digraphs; even oriented, and deletion of a specified root leaves a DAG of depth at most one.
scope_exclusions: No claim that finite tests substitute for the general proof.
No conflation with problem 3000016 multigraph reachability.
